name: MobiLens
tagline: AR glasses and agents that let people with paralysis call for help and control their surroundings by voice or hand.
problem: People with paralysis struggle to communicate and control their environment.
solution: AR overlays respond to voice or hand motion depending on ability; Fetch.ai agents handle emergency alerts with fall detection and communication with the surroundings.
demo_moment: Team-described: trigger a help alert by voice.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Fetch.ai” and “Best use of Snap AR” among 122 submissions.
Adapts the controls to the severity of paralysis.

lessons: Design the input for the person's ability, then reuse it everywhere.
